name: Bitfinex Ledgers (CSV)
description: Bitfinex 'Ledgers' report (bitfinex.com: Reports > Ledgers > Export, CSV). Header #, DESCRIPTION, CURRENCY, AMOUNT, BALANCE, DATE, WALLET. DATE is written day first ('15-01-2025 10:00:00', also '15-01-25 10:00:00') in the time zone set in the report preferences — UTC assumed; change timeZone if you export in another zone (or set the date format to DD-MM-YYYY before exporting). AMOUNT is signed; trading and withdrawal fees are rows of their own. The kind is read from the DESCRIPTION text ('Exchange 0.1 BTC for USD @ ...', 'Trading fees for ...', 'Deposit (BITCOIN) #...', '... Withdrawal #...', 'Transfer of ... from wallet Exchange to Margin ...', 'Staking Reward ...', 'Margin Funding Payment ...'). The wallet (exchange, margin, funding) becomes the account; the running BALANCE gives the balance per wallet and currency. The legs of a trade share their DATE (group). Known limits: margin positions (settlements, claims) are booked as trade; description texts Bitfinex adds later fall to unknown; UST is renamed to USDT and IOT to IOTA; other Bitfinex-specific codes are kept as written — add aliases if you need them.
